notes: Re-opening a panel from the Control Panel is now a real open. Closing a panel hides its window rather than destroying it, and re-opening simply showed that hidden window again - so what appeared was the previous session content, not a…

A hidden panel window is now discarded and rebuilt when you open it, so it opens at the loading height and plays the loader exactly as a first open does. Focusing a panel that is already on screen is unchanged.
